item.terrawrath.disaster_detector.toolti: Beeps when a disaster is coming. Use it for a threat report.
disaster.terrawrath.tornado.desc: A 160-block funnel that tears up the land and flings it for miles.
disaster.terrawrath.tornado.warning: Rotation detected. Take cover underground immediately.
disaster.terrawrath.volcano.desc: A mountain rises from the ground and erupts in fire and ash.
disaster.terrawrath.volcano.warning: Magma surging beneath your feet. Evacuate the area.
disaster.terrawrath.tsunami.desc: The sea pulls back... then a 40-block wall of water rolls in.
disaster.terrawrath.tsunami.warning: The sea is receding. Get to high ground NOW.
disaster.terrawrath.earthquake.desc: Glowing cracks race across the land and split into chasms.
disaster.terrawrath.earthquake.warning: Seismic activity off the scale. Stay away from buildings.
disaster.terrawrath.meteor.desc: Burning rocks rain from a green-lit sky. The last one is huge.
disaster.terrawrath.meteor.warning: Objects inbound from orbit. Find shelter.
disaster.terrawrath.storm.desc: A black-purple supercell with nonstop branching lightning.
disaster.terrawrath.storm.warning: Extreme electrical storm approaching. Get indoors.
disaster.terrawrath.blizzard.desc: A whiteout wall that freezes the land and anyone left outside.
disaster.terrawrath.blizzard.warning: Temperature collapse imminent. Light a fire and stay inside.
disaster.terrawrath.sinkhole.desc: The ground cracks in rings, then collapses into a deep pit.
disaster.terrawrath.sinkhole.warning: Ground instability detected. Move away from the cracks.
disaster.terrawrath.horizon.desc: A black hole is born overhead. It drinks the land, then goes supernova.
disaster.terrawrath.horizon.warning: Something is swallowing the light overhead. Do not look up.
terrawrath.welcome: TerraWrath: right-click the Disaster Control Panel to unleash a disaster. Good luck.
terrawrath.cinematic.hint: Cinematic camera. Sneak or use the panel again to exit.
terrawrath.detector.calm_eta: All quiet. Seismic models predict trouble within %s min.
screen.terrawrath.subtitle: DISASTER CONTROL
screen.terrawrath.front_on: Spawn: right in front of me
disaster.terrawrath.horizon.collapse.sub: The horizon is caving in. Get as far away as you can.
